_comment: Rule data for tools/qml_qt_api_guard.py. Every entry must come from the Qt documentation for the version named in 'sources' - do not add a member or version from memory. The guard fails closed: a member that is not listed under 'accessible' is rejected, so future Qt additions are caught without being known here.

sources.minimum_qt: CMakeLists.txt gates QML on Qt6_VERSION >= 6.4 ('We need Qt 6.4 for ComponentBehavior: Bound'); Linux CI is Ubuntu 24.04 with Qt 6.4.2 (tools/debian_buildenv.sh).
sources.accessible_qt64: https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.4/qml-qtquick-accessible.html - properties and signals of the Accessible attached type in Qt 6.4.3.
sources.accessible_later: https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qml-qtquick-accessible.html - later members carry a 'This property was introduced in Qt X.Y' note, or are absent from the 6.4 page.
sources.incident: docs/qml-i18n-a11y-notes.md section 1.2 - Qt 6.5-only Accessible properties failed to load on the Qt 6.4.2 Linux job.

imports.note: A versioned import such as 'import QtQuick 6.5' requires Qt >= 6.5 and fails the guard. Qt 5 style imports such as 'import QtQuick 2.15' are accepted by Qt 6 and never fail.
